## PR checklist

- [ ] Title is the final squash message (Conventional Commits)
- [ ] CI green (format → lint → typecheck → test → build, plus e2e)
- [ ] Regression/behavior tests added (or N/A with reason)
- [ ] Showcase demo added or extended for user-facing changes
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry for breaking or visual changes
- [ ] Scope contained — no unrelated changes, no secret material, no lockfile churn
